evidence: Lossless-extraction evidence only. Not HDS parity.
limitations: Silver shaping and normalization rules (fabric_silver/normalize.py) are re-implemented from reading the HDS v1.4.0 normalization source and are source-derived, UNVERIFIED against a captured HDS run; no captured reference data exists, so this is not verified parity. Columns carrying the pre-normalization value: idOrig, identifierOrig, meta_lastUpdatedOrig, meta.lastUpdatedOrig, effectiveDateTimeOrig, effectiveInstantOrig, issuedOrig, valueDateTimeOrig, effectivePeriod.startOrig/endOrig, valuePeriod.startOrig/endOrig. Other date/dateTime/instant values are parsed to UTC without an Orig copy. Known divergences: unknown JSON fields (including primitive extensions such as _birthDate) are rejected instead of dropped; msftFilePath is the logical path, not the OneLake URI; Spark from_json/to_json text formatting is emulated, not executed. Always-null Silver paths (source-derived, see tests/test_fabric_normalize.py always_null): every normalized Reference's .reference (normalize_ref_struct moves it to msftSourceReference) and its .identifier.period.{extension,id,start,end} (the raw Reference.identifier.period is a string, so conform_to_row_identifier_schema reads no members). Every other leaf path has a populated hand-derived example.
